source: Phone video by the repository owner: the same nearly solved cube after one more turn, over a white tiled floor. 10 frames per second, shrunk to 270 x 480.
note: faces: the 9 colours of each face in the order shown, row by row as seen. shown: when each face first comes into view, in seconds. within: how long after that a face may take to be captured (the yellow face slides partly out of the picture twice before it is held still). The 54 stickers form a valid cube. The white side is solved and its right edge is in front of white floor tiles, so it has no outline there. The green face is shown twice.
